text:
emma_csm: looped in team — Silverpine wants to onboard a customer-supplied ASR model for voice->text in claims intake. They say: PHI, private VPC only, HSM/bring-your-own-KMS, and latency target p95 <300ms. renewal at risk if this slips. :grimacing:

jordan_se: got it. do we know model size / framework? ONNX / PyTorch / torchscript?

emma_csm: they sent this note: '16GB quantized encoder, ONNX runtime, streaming support required, 8k context, small vocabulary mapping.' attached sample audio + transcript. I'll DM the files to eng.

jordan_se: sounds like Dedicated or Private Dedicated capacity. ONNX runtime is good but we need to validate KV cache support for streaming. will need perf run and fallback plan to our hosted small-asr model.

emma_csm: customer is sensitive to cost but cares more about accuracy and compliance. asks for an ETA on an onboarding plan and risk list by EOW.

priya_sg: security checklist for PHI onboard: 1) private control plane + VPC peering 2) BYOK + HSM keywrap 3) ingestion redaction pipeline (PII/PHI scrubbing) 4) audit logs + retention policy 5) contract addendum for egress. Also need an architecture diagram from eng.

ashley_eval: I can run a lightweight eval harness — propose metrics: WER, p95 latency (streaming), real-time factor, hallucination / insertion rate on 3 prompts sets (claims-utterances, caller id noise, accented speakers). I can run local A/B vs our hosted-small-asr.

jordan_se: for perf runs, please capture: p50/p95 token latency, CPU/GPU utilization, memory, and tail latency under concurrency=8,16. if p95 >300ms, consider 8-bit quant or XNNPACK kernel. Also plan for graceful degrade: switch to hosted-asr with notification header.

emma_csm: customer called out renewal risk — they said "if we can't go live by May 12, we'll re-evaluate". so timeline matters. Can we commit to a canary in Private by May 8?

priya_sg: May 8 is tight. we need SOC2 doc drop, SRA, and threat model review. can start parallel work but gating: key management + acceptance tests for redaction.

ashley_eval: I'll mock a small eval now to get ballpark numbers. sharing the quick run command for the eng perf bucket — jordan, can you confirm infra name?

jordan_se: use project=private-silverpine-canary, node-set=dedicated-g4dnx. i'll open infra ticket after convo.

ashley_eval: running the harness (sample):
```bash
curl -X POST https://perf.internal.redwood/run_eval \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_TOKEN' \n  -d '{"model_path":"s3://silverpine/asr.onnx","input_set":"s3://silverpine/eval_audio","metrics":["wer","latency_p95","rtf"]}'
```
I'll post the first pass results in ~2h.

onboard-bot: ticket CS-4821 created: "Silverpine ASR private onboarding" assigned to jordan_se. ETA field left blank.

emma_csm: perfect, thanks. next steps: jordan — infra ticket + canary plan; priya — list of security gating items; ashley — eval results + recommended acceptance thresholds; I'll prepare enablement doc for customer and renewal owner note.

jordan_se: I'll draft canary runbook and add fallback policies (model route, notification headers, cost caps). also propose dedicated pool with burst to hosted cluster.

priya_sg: also request they sign BAAs and confirm whether they want tokenization/redaction performed client-side or server-side. prefer client-side but we can offer server-side with strict logs retention and HSM only.

ashley_eval: first-pass numbers: WER 7.2% on claims set, p95 latency ~420ms on default runtime (no kernel tuning), RTF 0.35. will try kernel swap + quant and re-run.

emma_csm: thanks — that's the critical datapoint. please also surface any hallucination examples. I'll escalate timeline risk to AM/renewal.

jordan_se: if tuning drops p95 under 300ms we can propose May 8. otherwise propose gradual rollout with routing by header to hosted model for >300ms requests.

emma_csm: ok — keep this thread tight. I'll update Silverpine on expectation: preliminary eval in 48h, security gating list by EOD, infra ticket created. :thumbsup:

onboard-bot: CS-4821 status updated -> "in triage".

ashley_eval: will post tuned run here when done.

priya_sg: tagging legal for BAA. @emma_csm please add contract owner to thread when available.

emma_csm: will do. thanks all.
